# Ryan Duguid

Ryan Duguid builds open-source tools for Australian tax, payroll, financial reporting and accounting review.

## Selected work

- [payday-super-checker](https://github.com/ryanduguid/payday-super-checker): Checks contribution timing and prepares Payday Super exceptions for review.
- [xero-trial-balance-export](https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-trial-balance-export): Exports reconciled Xero trial balances to validated CSV for Power BI, Excel and pandas.
- [Ozzit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): Provides 134 native Excel LAMBDA functions for financial modelling and GST arithmetic.
- [accounting-excel-toolkit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-excel-toolkit): Power Query and VBA utilities for Australian ledger exports.
- [aus-accounting-mcp](https://github.com/ryanduguid/aus-accounting-mcp): A local MCP server for Australian accounting review, including ATO benchmarks, Payday Super and synthetic SBR fixtures.
- [australian-accounting-skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): Agent skills for Australian public-practice workflows, with human review and primary-source checks built in.
- [workpaper-review-gate](https://github.com/ryanduguid/workpaper-review-gate): Stops incomplete Australian public-practice workpaper packs before manager review.
- [australian-accounting-power-bi](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-power-bi): A source-controlled Power BI project for Australian accounting analytics, consolidation and review.
- [monthly-close-controls](https://github.com/ryanduguid/monthly-close-controls): Builds deterministic close checks and exception packs from Xero-shaped trial balances.
- [au-tax-legislation-corpus](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-legislation-corpus): Builds a provenance-rich corpus of in-force Commonwealth tax legislation.

Portfolio: https://ryanduguid.github.io/
